🥥 When to plant coconut in Nigeria

Also called Àgbọn (Yoruba) and Kwakwa (Hausa).

Quick answer: Plant coconut in Nigeria from April to July and harvest from all year round. Seedlings are planted in the rains; mature palms give nuts all year.

PlantApril to July
Harvestall year round
Grows inSouth-West and South-South
TypeTree & cash crops
Local namesÀgbọn · Kwakwa

■ plant   ■ harvest

About coconut

Coconut thrives in sandy coastal soils, like the Badagry coast in Lagos.

How to plant coconut well

Plant at least 8–9 m apart for good sunlight.

Seedlings are planted in the rains; mature palms give nuts all year.

Diseases and pests of coconut

  • Lethal yellowing-type disease (Awka wilt)Cut and burn infected palms quickly; plant tolerant varieties.
  • Rhinoceros beetleRemove rotting logs where larvae breed.

Best states for coconut

Lagos · Ogun · Rivers · Akwa Ibom · Cross River · Bayelsa · Delta · Ondo

Questions farmers ask

When is the best time to plant coconut in Nigeria?

Plant coconut in Nigeria from April to July and harvest from all year round. Seedlings are planted in the rains; mature palms give nuts all year.

What is coconut called in Yoruba, Hausa and Igbo?

Coconut is called Àgbọn (Yoruba) and Kwakwa (Hausa).

When is coconut harvested in Nigeria?

Coconut is usually harvested from all year round.

Which Nigerian states grow the most coconut?

Lagos, Ogun, Rivers, Akwa Ibom, Cross River, Bayelsa, Delta and Ondo are among the best-known coconut states.

Can I grow coconut in my part of Nigeria?

Coconut grows best in the South-West and South-South regions. In other regions, ask your ADP extension officer before planting.

What diseases attack coconut and how do I prevent them?

Lethal yellowing-type disease (Awka wilt): Cut and burn infected palms quickly; plant tolerant varieties. Rhinoceros beetle: Remove rotting logs where larvae breed.
